primary_excerpt: "The naira appreciated by 6.96 percent, or N100.07, on a year-on-year basis to close at N1,435.75 per dollar... compared with N1,535.82 recorded in the corresponding period of December 31, 2024, at the Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market.
